subject: Procurement reboard + term-swap: site capacity uplift playbook
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightlanehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlanehealth.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reboard + term change: procurement steps for capacity uplift

Hi Jonas,

Hope you had a good week. We're kicking off our renewal discussion at BrightLane and expect to increase site capacity by ~3x starting July. Because the renewal includes a term change (moving from annual to 24-month billing cadence) and an expanded data-residency addendum, our procurement team requires a vendor reboarding.

Can you share the high-level procurement checklist and the artifacts you need to complete onboarding in your procurement portal (e.g., updated W-9, SOC2 attestation, signed SOW, PO format)? We have an internal deadline to finalize purchase paperwork by Apr 22 to meet July start.

Attachments: BrightLane_Vendor_Profile.pdf (company profile, tax id, billing contact)

Two ask items from our side:
- Is there a fast-track for reboarding when the vendor is already active but changing terms?
- Who on your side owns PO acceptance vs. contract signature?

Appreciate any checklist or a short call this week.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager | BrightLane Health
procurement@brightlanehealth.com

-----

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightlanehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reboard + term change: procurement steps for capacity uplift

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and the profile. Congrats on the expansion — excited to support BrightLane as you scale.

Short answers up front: yes, there is a streamlined reboarding path for existing customers; we call it a "reboard-lite" for term-only changes where most baseline attestations are current. That said, because you're also adding a data-residency addendum (and the term cadence is changing), we will need a few items to clear the procurement portal and finance gates.

Required (what we need to accept PO & finalize invoicing):
- Executed SOW (use our SOW template) — lists new capacity, billing cadence, and start date
- Signed PO from BrightLane with tax id and billing contact (pdf)
- Confirmation of billing entity (if different from profile)
- W-9 or local tax equivalent if entity changed

Compliance/controls (we already have older copies on file; we'll verify freshness):
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12 months) or AICPA bridge letter
- Data residency addendum signed (we have a templated addendum for region-specific terms)

Operational (recommendations to avoid delays):
- Provide expected date for PO issuance and preferred invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly)
- If you need credits or billing proration for mid-cycle start, flag it now — I can route to finance for an exception approval.

Fast-track process: if you can provide the SOW + PO by Apr 15, we can queue for expedited reboarding and aim for PO acceptance within 3 business days. Otherwise standard processing is ~10 business days.

I've attached our SOW template and highlighted the sections you'll want to fill for capacity details. Happy to hop on a 30-min call Wed or Thu to walk through.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Template_v2.docx (SOW fields + billing instructions)

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Sending PO as attachment. Please confirm the PO number and let me know if finance needs anything else.

Marta
